early_stopping.rule: Stop only from measured prediction stability, response-bound margin, decay fit quality, or negligible settling-bound change. Ground truth is never an input to the stopping decision.

experiment.scientific_question: Does a zero-force causal observation period after the chirp provide enough ring-down information to eliminate or substantially reduce false-safe decisions without applying additional probing energy?
experiment.title: Stage 1 passive ring-down safety observation

chirp_only.description: EXP-0005 combined chirp set; stiffness diagnostic plus causal spectral/time features

chirp_ringdown.description: chirp plus passive ring-down features; primary set

physical_chirp_ringdown.description: diagnostic estimated k/c/m_eff plus chirp and ring-down features

ringdown_only.description: causal passive-response features available by the decision time

future_contact_maneuver.description: identical hidden sustained-contact maneuver to EXP-0005

legacy_exp_0005_false_safe_audit.policy: Reproduce after the EXP-0006 models and stopping rule are frozen. These known targets are a locked failure audit and are not EXP-0006 validation.

predictor.class_rule: SAFE only when every calibrated upper response bound is inside the SAFE envelope and the contact-travel bound is clear; UNSAFE when any upper bound exceeds the UNSAFE envelope or contact travel; CAUTION otherwise.

passive_persistence_veto.justification: A measured amplitude time constant above the 2 s SAFE settling limit is not sufficient evidence for SAFE while a residual response at least three displacement-noise standard deviations remains and the response has spent less than 10 percent of the observed window below the displacement/velocity thresholds. This physics-based veto is common to every target and noise regime and never promotes a target to SAFE.

ringdown_features.definitions: All features use only samples from probe end through the current decision time: exponential envelope decay/r2, dominant frequency, peak-to-peak logarithmic decrement and damping-ratio diagnostic, residual peak/rms, observed time below thresholds, zero-crossing rate, and kinematic-energy proxy decay.

safe_force_definition.definition: identical diagnostic definition to EXP-0005; not a Stage 1 gate in EXP-0006

scope_exclusions: centered or noncausal filtering as a primary result

stage1_safety_criterion.rule: Stage 1 may proceed only if at least one fixed passive duration no longer than 2 s meets both false-safe limits, accuracy and unsafe-recall limits, adds no probing energy, and detects every nominal EXP-0005 false-safe case.

target_population.policy: identical continuous log-space population definition to EXP-0005
